title: Under review: rank137 cross-copy candidate; inherited operator obstruction
body:
**Mathematical status correction (2026-10-11): the claimed gain is not currently established.** I reproduced [PR451's cross-family trace obstruction](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/451) at `f3a38153678b55063fc005901cc968266166507d`. For a rank2 bit residual and an idle second family, the whole operator has trace90 while the proposed rank1/rank1 split has trace54 (q=3,m=2). The complex analogue has traces4+2i and4+4i. This contradicts the elementary coordinate-permutation derivation inherited from PR448, which this PR uses. Our finite packing, local scalar, invoice and full-wrapper checks pass but do not test that physical cross-family operator identity. The numerical κ below is therefore a score under an unresolved, specifically challenged interface, not an established improvement. A different explicitly charged compiler/global regrouping theorem would be required to repair it. The draft and all evidence are retained for review; the newer pooled-replica candidate is affected as well and will not be submitted as a winning bound on this basis.

---

**Submitted as a draft first. Fresh full-wrapper replays have now PASSed on Python3.11.15 and3.14.8, including the complete parent chain, record mutations and Gram checks. Both full results agree exactly. GitHub CI is separate and currently queued.**

Conditional candidate **κ = 0.001347781996192312**, bit-bound: **+0.00277860352249% over #450** at `6faca41020a620689de013cdab9f61a22deca314`.

Remove pivot744 from #443's rank138 kernel, apply #450's target mixing, and re-optimize #448 cross-copy hosting. The resulting rank137 selection replaces the rank14 partial idle remainder with rank3. R stays740; all65,120 residuals are hosted with9,600 live families. Our rank147 kernel was worse under this objective; its negative result is retained.

Passed on the changed construction: exact980-column mixed-word replay and four controls; C++ legality and five/eleven-stage columns; exact geometry and parent audit; independent cross-copy audit and20 controls; regenerated #448 complex template matching its pinned hash and five complex controls; both rational moments, fresh invoices, six bootstrap levels and47 strict inequalities with next-grid and parameter controls. Emitted instruction count1,716,352.

The full verifier is `research/e8-cross-copy-rank137/verify.py`. The initial submission reused the already completed PR447 parent suppliers. The subsequently published `e8-cross-copy-rank137-validation/python311` and `python314` receipts each document a fresh full run of this package and its parent chain. A missing-SymPy launch failure is retained along with the corrected audit.

This retains #442 idle-data hosting, #448 cross-copy hosting, #450's bit target-label conjugation review point, and all inherited compiler/dirty-helper/precision/analytic assumptions. No unconditional multiplication theorem or Lean proof is claimed. Conservative row allowance28,416 is charged explicitly.

Credits: DreamingOfClouds (#450 target mixing and stage tools), higherbeing (#448 cross-copy hosting), chafreaky (#443–445 kernel and staging), DaysSky, icekylinx, eumemic, Zhihao Chen, Dylan Crow, Jacob Sussman and the inherited authors. Rank137 selection/composition prepared by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex assistance; original notices and licenses retained.

Post-submission anchor: the independent rank138 screen exactly reproduced #450 κ0.001347744547714835. The new profile differs per eight-replica group by `{1: -88, 2: -176, 3: +184, 14: -8}`; all other global counts match. A floating MILP over subsets of the123 compatible known relations also nominated the same113-entry rank137 selection; this is a scoped search result, not an exact optimality theorem.

Full tested manifest: `8441fa7b22a19ec4ac31625d0c7c2f9d581b43c970406cc8d85e6f390a82c14d`. After the passes, only README status/wording and its manifest were updated; all executable source, frozen inputs and expected results are unchanged. The exact documentation-only diff is retained.
